answer: Grant each identity a 260-unit refundable bond and an eighteen-epoch probation. Every epoch it completes one randomized task and needs four attestations from peers whose recent contact sets do not overlap; recycled proofs, duplicated wording, or clock-synchronized submissions freeze the bond for six epochs. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. Each sybil alias locks 260 units and repeats eighteen rounds, while timber traces reveal shared history; grove routing scatters tasks, and lotus seals mark verified records.
